record.context_brief: Weak Baire measurability of the supremum norm
record.original_question: Let K be compact. Is the weak Baire measurability of the supremum norm on C(K), viewed as measurability with respect to Ba(C(K), w), equivalent to weak*-separability of the dual unit ball B_{C(K)^*} or of the whole dual space C(K)^*?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.3. Let K be compact. Is the measurability of ||·||_∞ with respect to Ba(C(K), w) equivalent to the weak*-separability of B_{C(K)^*} or C(K)^*?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K$ be a compact Hausdorff space and let $C(K)$ denote the Banach space of continuous real-valued functions on $K$ endowed with the supremum norm $\|\cdot\|_\infty$. Let $w$ denote the weak topology on $C(K)$, and let $\mathrm{Ba}(C(K),w)$ be the Baire $\sigma$-algebra of $(C(K),w)$, i.e., the smallest $\sigma$-algebra on $C(K)$ making every weakly continuous real-valued function on $C(K)$ measurable (equivalently, the $\sigma$-algebra generated by the weakly continuous functions, or by the sets $\{x : x^*(x) \le t\}$ for $x^* \in C(K)^*$, $t \in \mathbb{R}$). Let $C(K)^*$ denote the topological dual of $C(K)$, and let $B_{C(K)^*}$ denote its closed unit ball, both considered with the weak* topology.

It is known that the following implications hold:
$$ B_{C(K)^*}\text{ is weak*-separable} \;\Longrightarrow\; \|\cdot\|_\infty \text{ is } \mathrm{Ba}(C(K),w)\text{-measurable} \;\Longrightarrow\; C(K)^* \text{ is weak*-separable}, $$
and that in general neither converse holds for arbitrary Banach spaces.

Question: For every compact Hausdorff space $K$, is the $\mathrm{Ba}(C(K),w)$-measurability of the supremum norm $\|\cdot\|_\infty$ equivalent to the weak*-separability of $B_{C(K)^*}$? Equivalently or alternatively, is it equivalent to the weak*-separability of $C(K)^*$?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears to remain open. Related work by Avilés, Plebanek, and Rodríguez establishes the chain of implications between weak*-separability of $B_{C(K)^*}$, weak Baire measurability of the supremum norm, and weak*-separability of $C(K)^*$, and shows in ZFC that there exists $K$ with $C(K)^*$ weak*-separable but $B_{C(K)^*}$ not weak*-separable. However, the equivalence question for $C(K)$ spaces (whether weak Baire measurability of $\|\cdot\|_\infty$ coincides with one of these separability properties) is explicitly stated as an open problem and no resolution was found in the search.

status_evidence.title: A weak* separable C(K)* space whose unit ball is not weak* separable
status_evidence.snippet: A ZFC example of a compact space K such that C(K)* is weak*-separable but its closed unit ball is not weak*-separable.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes that weak*-separability of C(K)* does not imply weak*-separability of its unit ball, relevant to the chain of implications around the question.

status_evidence.title: Weak Baire measurability of the balls in a Banach space (J. Rodríguez)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses weak Baire measurability of norms and balls in Banach spaces and the implications connecting it to weak*-separability of the dual and its unit ball.
status_evidence.claim: Confirms the implications and the standing open question for C(K) spaces.
